facts.business: CIAN Agro Industries & Infrastructure Limited operates in agro industry (edible oils, packaged staples, sugar, spices, exports), infrastructure sector, and healthcare sector (biomedical waste management).

auditor.name: P. G. Joshi & Co. LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: (a) impairment assessment of Refinery CGU - no impairment loss recognized; (b) unquoted equity investments carried at cost without fair valuation; (c) write-back of non-current borrowings and trade payables recognized as other income; (d) trade receivables and payables balances subject to reconciliation/confirmation; (e) inventories valued at cost/NRV without verification records; (f) revenue recognition based on intimation of approval from contracting party; (g) no ECL provision on current receivables; (h) NCLT approval of resolution plan for Shubhada Tool Industries Pvt Ltd - financials not consolidated.

key_risks: Geopolitical developments in Middle East/West Asia affecting energy markets
Inflationary pressures from energy prices and financial market volatility
Dependence on weather conditions for agricultural performance

No ECL provision on current receivables

Write-back of borrowings and payables constituting substantial portion of other income

facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties are in compliance with section 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 and details have been disclosed in the Financial Statements as required by applicable Indian accounting standards.
